summary: Shadow jobs build the genie-freshness and typescript-client check derivations on a ci1 runner in merge groups and sign them as nix records; the notes are retained and read by nothing yet

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change; a Nix check and a refresh script only.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. Nothing reads the check's result to skip a CI job.

compatibility.detail: No required check changes and no job depends on the new ones; they are continue-on-error and run only for merge groups.
